predicted:
$f(x)=1-x$（减函数），$g(x)=x$（增函数）：  
- $\int_0^1 f(x)dx = \int_0^1 (1-x)dx = \frac{1}{2}$  
- $\int_0^1 g(x)dx = \int_0^1 x dx = \frac{1}{2}$  
- $\int_0^1 f(x)g(x)dx = \int_0^1 (x-x^2)dx = \frac{1}{6}$  
- $\int f \int g = \frac{1}{4} > \frac{1}{6} = \int f g$，满足条件。
